verdict.rationale: Godot exposes substantial scripting/automation surfaces — CLI for project management/export/headless runs, EditorScript for scripted editor operations, EditorInterface for controlling the editor window/scenes/resources, and a plugin API for extending editor tooling — which together let AI-native users automate much of what the UI does. However, there's no documented guarantee of full UI/API parity, no OpenAPI/machine-readable spec (probes return 404s), and no evidence that every UI-only feature (e.g. certain visual editors, inspectors) has a scriptable equivalent. missing for 10: explicit API-parity documentation, machine-readable/OpenAPI spec, and evidence that all UI-exclusive workflows can be fully replicated via API/CLI.
